findings:
🔴 [d2-generation-immutability] MUST-FIX `handleCollect` deletes and recreates an aborted generation directory and has a production `phase === 'p7'` exception allowing a successor after a merely pending generation; this permits evidence overwrite and breaks the finalized contiguous-chain contract. Reject every reused generation/directory, require every predecessor to be finalized, and remove the test-specific exception. 🔴 [d2-seat-receipt-forgery] MUST-FIX receipt validation accepts `seat_artifact_sha256: {}` with no seat metadata, trusts an optional minimum supplied by the receipt, and never derives reviewed status from seat artifacts; an implementer can fabricate an empty-finding SHIP-AS-IS chain without any reviewer evidence. Require a positive minimum from trusted configuration, exact seat-to-hash coverage, and semantic validation of every seat artifact. 🟠 [d2-plan-candidate-blocker-fail-open] MUST-FIX Mode B changed `candidate_blocker` from mandatory boolean to optional, so a malformed finding can omit the field and evade blocker-specific disposition checks. Require the boolean on every canonical plan finding and verify matching classification in its disposition. 🟠 [d2-open-findings-drift] MUST-FIX the checker validates `open_findings` only when present and accepts a numeric count while the shared format requires verified Major/Minor findings to populate the canonical array; a forged receipt can omit their actionable details and still pass. Require the array and deep equality with the re-derived entries. 🟠 [d1-runner-alias-exclusion] MUST-FIX plan-review and consult collision/exclusion checks compare runner strings directly, so `codex-cli` and `codex` are treated as different rails despite the required alias equivalence, allowing a supposedly excluded same-runner or QC seat to be selected. Canonicalize runner aliases before every collision and tuple-key comparison. 🟠 [d2-phase-base-location] MUST-FIX collection writes `phase-

.base` inside `ledger/review-

/`, while both documented gate commands read it from `ledger/phase-

.base`; the prescribed phase gate therefore fails even after a valid collection. Make the writer and documented consumer use the same path.
